Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like your sharper customer focus makes dependable, long-term business especially important. We value our relationship and want a straightforward renewal that supports that continuity. How could a longer commitment support better pricing, and could you share your cost-breakdown XLSX so we can work from its underlying elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 90 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like the financing cost of extended payment is offsetting the certainty you gain from a longer commitment. We want a straightforward renewal that supports your longer-term planning. How can we translate that commitment into a final price step and conclude the renewal?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. That supports a price of about EUR 4.41.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.93 per unit, 90 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
We appreciate the provided call-off schedule and your commitment to a 36-month term.
However, the financing costs associated with 90-day payment terms prevent any further price reductions.
Therefore, €4.94 per unit is our final offer for this package.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
